Each of your four reference screens sits beside a mockup built only from this system's tokens and components. The references set the look; tabs, tags and statuses come from the app as it is today. Home

  • HomeHero: eyebrow, serif heroTitle on two lines, heroSubtitle, over your riders-at-sunset photo, mirrored so the riders sit on the right, with photoSideFade and photoFade.
  • LogoBadge and the connection FloatingButton float on the photo. There is no app bar.
  • ACTIVE RIDE shows the app's ride status (IN LOBBY / RIDING).
  • ActionButtonPair: accent Create with a dark plus disc; glass Join.
  • ActiveRideCard: DestinationPill, AvatarStack (when participants load), cardTitle, distance and estimated-time MetaChips, ResumePill.
  • RideRowCard: destination thumbnail, distance, LEADER badge when you led, date, and RESUME. Home lists rides still running, so each row has RESUME.
  • BottomNavFloating: History · Home · Profile. The active tab (Home) sits in the raised accent circle.

Lobby

  • The destination photo runs to the top edge; back, edit and more are FloatingButtons.
  • HeroTitleBlock: RIDE eyebrow, serif title, the ride status (In lobby / Riding), and the place.
  • StatTiles size to their content. STATUS shows Ready or Waiting; CODE is mono.
  • RosterRow: role line RIDE LEADER / FORMATION RIDER; badge READY (accent), WAITING (grey) or RIDING (green). The ride here is active, so everyone shows RIDING; offline riders get a grey dot. The leader row keeps the accent bar.
  • DetailsList, then a sticky RESUME NAVIGATION PrimaryButton with a dark direction glyph. Scroll the mockup to see Ride details.
Reference · Lobby, solo

Lobby, solo

  • Same components as the crew lobby. With one rider the Ride details list is visible without scrolling.
  • The built Lobby mockup covers this state: scroll it to Ride details.

Edit ride

  • Pushed header: a dark FloatingButton back, centred tracked title and subtitle, the accent connection button, over your road-at-sunset photo, faded.
  • RouteTimeline: rail markers (green start, olive stop, accent destination) sit outside the cards, and the labels line up with the cards.
  • LocationCard: dark disc with an accent glyph, title and city, round × to clear. Each stop has a solid salmon remove button.
  • RouteMapCard: accent route with a soft glow, ringed start and destination markers, recenter FloatingButton; VIEW ON MAP sits in the heading.
  • MetricCards with dark icon discs, then SAVE RIDE. No bottom nav.

Same language, other screens

  • Navigation: map edge to edge, floating glass turn card, leaderboard pills, category banner, a floating stat bar matching the bottom nav.
  • Summary: the destination photo hero (your road photo when there is none) with a serif title, MetaChips, the 2×2 metric grid, and awards drawn as roster rows.
  • These two have no reference yet. Share one if you have it and I'll match it.
Accent

The one bright colour

All accent shades are derived from the colour in the bar. The default is your choice, ice cyan (#3DE8FF). The lime sampled from the references is the second swatch. When you settle on a colour, copy the tokens and paste them back to Claude.

Decisions
Settled so far

    

      
check_circleAccent is ice cyan #3DE8FF. Tabs are History · Home · Profile with the app's icons; the active tab sits in the raised accent circle.

      
check_circleTags and statuses come only from the app (READY / WAITING / RIDING, IN LOBBY / RIDING, RIDE LEADER / FORMATION RIDER, LEADER on ride rows).

      
check_circleHero photos: riders at sunset for Home, the empty road for Edit Ride, History, Auth and as the Summary fallback.

      
check_circleRide thumbnails use each ride's destination photo, with a map snapshot when there is none.

      
check_circleThe bottom nav stays visible in the lobby. It stays hidden on the full-screen navigation map.
